name: simsa-same-origin-demo
description: Build and start the SIMSA frontend and API as one same-origin service

scripts.build:full: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:cloud-metadata: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/cloud-metadata-config.test.mjs scripts/neon-target.test.mjs scripts/neon-database.test.mjs scripts/neon-database-policy.test.mjs scripts/neon-first-admin.test.mjs
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:manifest && npm run test:hosting && npm run test:launcher && npm run test:demo-image && npm run test:backup-drill && npm run test:local-current-backup && npm run test:cloud-metadata && npm run test:cloud-access && npm run test:vercel-deployment && npm run test:neon-backup
scripts.test:manifest: npm --prefix frontend exec -- vitest run src/lib/build-manifest.test.js
